card.name: Words in ALL-CAPS warning text
card.fires_on: Words and word pieces in ALL-CAPS label text, often right before OF or AND. Seen in warning sentences such as THE USE OF, RISK OF, DIAGNOSIS OF.

modes.label: Noun before OF
modes.description: Capitalized noun like USE, RISK, PREPARATION or DIAGNOSIS that is followed by OF.
modes.example: THE R<<ISK>> OF UTERINE RUPTURE IN

modes.label: Partway through capitalized drug or condition names
modes.description: Ending pieces of capitalized names such as FLUMAZENIL or ANEMIA in warning text.
modes.example: WARNINGS: THE USE OF FLUMAZEN<<IL>> HAS BEEN ASSOCIATED WITH THE OCC

card.writes: It pushes the model toward capitalized connecting words like AND, OF and DI, and away from capitalized code-style tokens.
card.plain: It fires inside warning sentences written in all capitals, where the next word is likely a capitalized OF or AND.
